tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A near-white warm tint in light, a soft deep teal in dark. Keep most of every screen on this.

tokens.name: surface-nav
tokens.usage: Side bars and tool bars: one step off `surface` so navigation reads as its own area without a heavy fill.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, menus, the selected segment of a segmented control. Pure white in light.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented control tracks, log and code boxes, progress tracks, empty photo slots.

tokens.name: surface-frame
tokens.usage: The brand cream, used as an accent: the photo mat around tiles, the selected step or row, the app icon frame. Never a whole page or side bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections and around cards. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and step circles. A cool teal-grey rather than brown so it stays light. 3.1:1 or better on `surface`, `surface-nav`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. Wordmark teal in light; a soft cream in dark, held near 12:1 rather than 16:1 so the dark theme is calm, not stark. 9:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, hints, timestamps, inactive navigation. 4.7:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, the active step number, switch on, selected photo ring. The one main action per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-hover` (8.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Secondary brand green from the back photo tile. Links, Back, progress fills, uploading status. 5.3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: How a step stands, as traffic lights in Keevoro's own palette: done, under way, to come, and gone wrong. Never the only sign; each has its own shape as well.

tokens.name: status-doing
tokens.usage: How a step stands, as traffic lights in Keevoro's own palette: done, under way, to come, and gone wrong. Never the only sign; each has its own shape as well.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: How a step stands, as traffic lights in Keevoro's own palette: done, under way, to come, and gone wrong. Never the only sign; each has its own shape as well.

tokens.name: status-problem
tokens.usage: How a step stands, as traffic lights in Keevoro's own palette: done, under way, to come, and gone wrong. Never the only sign; each has its own shape as well.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a status colour.

tokens.name: pine-soft
tokens.usage: Background for uploading badges and pine highlights. Pair with `pine` text.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The sun. Accent fill for the New badge, illustration and the cover. Never as text; text on it is `on-sun`.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sun` fills (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text: warnings and the New label. 5.4:1 or better on every surface and on `peach-soft`.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: The sky in the logo. Illustration, placeholder art, storage meter segment. Not a text ground.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Background for New and warning badges. Pair with `sun-ink` text.

tokens.name: hill
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the hill shape in placeholders, empty states and the cover.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Backed up. A blue-teal, kept off the red-green axis so it never relies on hue against `danger`. Always with the check icon and a word. 5.4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for backed-up badges. Pair with `success` text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Needs attention: failed uploads, storage full, destructive actions. Always with the attention icon and a word. 5.1:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for attention badges and inline errors. Pair with `danger` text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then a solid 2px ring. 4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: map-photo
tokens.usage: Photos on the map of where the space goes, and in its share bars and key: a soft apricot, calm on a drive that is nearly all photos. Edged with `map-photo-edge`; labels on it are `ink`. The full `sun` is kept for the box chosen.

tokens.name: map-photo-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a photo box on the map: at least 3:1 against `surface` and against `map-photo`, so boxes are told apart by their edges.

tokens.name: map-video
tokens.usage: Videos on the map: a soft sea green, always striped, so colour is never the only sign.

tokens.name: map-video-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a video box on the map.

tokens.name: map-carried
tokens.usage: Other files chosen to carry along, on the map: a soft lavender with level lines.

tokens.name: map-carried-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a box of other files to carry along.

tokens.name: map-music
tokens.usage: Music on the map, for a backup that is for music: a soft sky blue.

tokens.name: map-music-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a box of music on the map.

tokens.name: map-other
tokens.usage: Everything else on the map: nearly the ground, so what Keevoro would not back up stays quiet.

tokens.name: map-other-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a box of everything else.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Only where the logo files cannot go, such as live text in a cover or a social card. Prefer the Logos assets everywhere else.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing headlines and onboarding. One per screen.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Album names, list item titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: All 3,880 photos from this phone are safely backed up.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Hints, secondary lines, captions under photos. Usually in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, form labels, tabs, segmented controls. Medium (500), so controls read clearly without shouting.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section labels above lists. Set uppercase in CSS; write the source text in sentence case.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: File names, sizes, counts and checksums. Tabular numbers that should not jump while uploading.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between photo tiles in a dense grid; icon to label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked form rows and badge rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and onboarding spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small thumbnails, checkboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Photo tiles and the app icon shape: the soft square from the logo.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, switches, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Photo tiles, menus, the soft lift under the logo's tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the photo viewer.
